name: ASGI servers: Uvicorn, Granian, Gunicorn worker model
short_definition: How to run FastAPI/Starlette apps in production: Uvicorn (default ASGI server, uvloop/httptools) as the safe 2026 baseline; Granian (Rust HTTP core, ASGI/RSGI/WSGI) as a measured performance alternative with built-in workers; Gunicorn primarily as process manager for sync WSGI or historical Gunicorn+UvicornWorker hybrid. As of 2026-07-13: uvicorn 0.51.0, granian 2.7.9, gunicorn 26.0.0. Real APIs are usually DB-bound — server choice is rarely the first optimization.
scope_in: Uvicorn single/multi worker and reload for dev
Granian CLI: --interface asgi, workers, loops, HTTP/2, metrics, proxy wrappers
Gunicorn role: sync WSGI default; UvicornWorker hybrid pattern
Worker sizing for async I/O-bound services vs sync
Docker/K8s: one worker per container vs multi-worker process
Graceful shutdown, max-requests recycling, health probes
scope_out: Nginx/Caddy full reverse-proxy cookbook beyond app-server touchpoints
Trio-only Hypercorn deep dive except as niche alternative

defaults.prod_baseline: uvicorn with workers=cores (or 1 worker per k8s pod) + proxy for TLS
defaults.prod_alt_measured: granian --interface asgi --workers N after profiling shows server/I/O headroom gains
defaults.containers: Prefer 1 process worker per container and horizontal scale; simpler memory/cgroup accounting
defaults.tls: Terminate TLS at load balancer/ingress; app speaks HTTP on private port
defaults.worker_math_async: ≈ CPU cores (or cores+1) total across deployment unit; async workers multiplex many connections
defaults.recycle: max-requests + jitter (uvicorn) or workers-lifetime / workers-max-rss (granian) to contain leaks

use_uvicorn_when: Need maximum community docs and debugging familiarity
No measured need for Granian's RPS/memory edge
use_granian_when: Synthetic or connection-heavy load shows clear win after app profiling
Want single binary ASGI+HTTP/2 without Gunicorn composition
Production users already on Granian (paperless, reflex, searxng; cited Microsoft/Mozilla/Sentry usage in project status)
Need RSGI or built-in static offload carefully scoped
use_gunicorn_when: Existing ops standards mandate Gunicorn process model
Legacy hybrid: gunicorn -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker (still valid; not required if uvicorn multi-worker suffices)
do_not: Switch servers for hello-world benchmark vanity
Run many multi-worker processes inside tiny memory pods without math
Use Hypercorn unless HTTP/3/QUIC or Trio is a hard requirement

do: Match concurrency model: async app → async server workers
Set timeouts at proxy and app for slow clients
Configure trusted proxy / forwarded headers correctly (uvicorn proxy headers; granian wrap_asgi_with_proxy_headers)
preStop sleep / graceful SIGTERM drain in k8s
Expose /healthz for readiness independent of heavy deps when possible
dont: Don't size async workers with sync Gunicorn (2c+1) cargo-cult
Don't ignore keep-alive + backpressure interactions (Granian docs warn)
Don't put secrets in process command lines that land in ps/logs
Don't enable free-threaded Python Granian mode in production (project marks experimental/discouraged)

code_skeleton:
# Dev
# uv run uvicorn mypkg.main:app --reload --port 8000

# Prod uvicorn multi-worker (VM/systemd)
# uv run uvicorn mypkg.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 4 --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips='*'
# tighten forwarded-allow-ips to real proxy CIDRs in production

# Optional hybrid still seen in 2026
# gunicorn -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker -w 4 -b 0.0.0.0:8000 mypkg.main:app

# Granian ASGI
# uv run granian --interface asgi --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 4 mypkg.main:app
# optional: --loop uvloop  (via granian[uvloop])
# optional metrics: --metrics --metrics-port 9090

# Dockerfile CMD example (1 worker/pod)
# CMD ["uvicorn", "mypkg.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

# Granian proxy headers (app wrap) when behind reverse proxy:
# from granian.utils.proxies import wrap_asgi_with_proxy_headers
# app = wrap_asgi_with_proxy_headers(app, trusted_hosts="10.0.0.0/8")
failure_modes: Too many workers × pool size → Postgres max_connections exhaustion
Wrong forwarded headers → broken HTTPS redirects, wrong client IP rate limits
No graceful shutdown → 502 spikes on deploy
Memory leak without worker recycle → OOMKill
reload or debug flags left on in prod
Assuming Granian synthetic 2× RPS appears on DB-bound CRUD (often <10% real difference)
Granian ASGI extension gaps vs Uvicorn for niche Starlette features (check issue tracker)
anti_patterns: uWSGI for new greenfield ASGI apps
Binding 0.0.0.0 without network policy in shared hosts
Agent defaulting every project to Granian without measurement

versions_as_of.note: Secondary articles still calling Granian 'pre-1.0' are outdated — major version is 2.x in 2026

deprecation_watch: Pure waitresse/twisted stacks for new FastAPI
Assuming Gunicorn is required for all FastAPI prod (uvicorn multi-worker is fine for many)
ts_boundary: Next.js on Vercel/Node is a different runtime — Python ASGI servers only apply to Python services. BFF calls Python over HTTP/SSE; keep timeouts aligned (Next fetch timeout vs uvicorn/granian/proxy). Do not run Python ASGI inside Next serverless without a dedicated service host.
rust_boundary: Granian already uses Rust for HTTP I/O; further gains usually need app logic in Rust (Axum), not another ASGI server swap. If the bottleneck is Python business logic/CPU, changing Uvicorn→Granian won't save you.
supabase_boundary: Pool math: workers × SQLAlchemy pool × replicas < Postgres max_connections (and Supabase pooler limits). Prefer transaction pooler for serverless-like churn; session pooler only when required. ASGI worker count is a first-class input to pool sizing (see py-db-pool-lifecycle).
boundary_contracts: Trusted proxy CIDR list as config
Structured access logs optional; app structlog separate

decision_matrix_row.problem_class: Serve Python ASGI app in production
decision_matrix_row.python: Uvicorn default; Granian after measure; Gunicorn for sync WSGI
decision_matrix_row.rust: Skip ASGI; native Axum service if Python runtime is the problem

threats: Proxy header spoofing (client IP, proto) if trust all hosts
Exposed metrics port without auth/network policy
Request smuggling at misconfigured proxy chains (mitigate with standard proxy config)
Overly large backlog/backpressure settings enabling resource exhaustion
mitigations: forwarded-allow-ips / trusted_hosts strict CIDRs — never * in multi-tenant edge without reason
Bind metrics to localhost or scrape via private network
Resource limits on pods; workers-max-rss on Granian
Rate limit at edge for public APIs

must_generate: Worker count rationale comment or 1-worker container default
Pinned uvicorn (and granian if used) in pyproject

tests_required: Smoke boot under chosen server in CI (uvicorn)
Load test only when changing server class
Proxy header unit tests if custom trust logic
ci_gates: Image builds with production server command
uv lock contains declared server deps

positive: uvicorn without reload in prod manifests
1 worker per container or documented multi-worker
forwarded-allow-ips or granian proxy wrap with CIDR
negative: trusted_hosts="*" / forwarded-allow-ips=* on public edge without justification

skill_module_bullets: Default ASGI server: uvicorn[standard] 0.51.x; Granian 2.7.x opt-in after profiling
Async workers ≈ cores; don't cargo-cult Gunicorn 2c+1 for FastAPI
Containers: prefer 1 worker/pod + HPA; watch DB pool multiplication
Gunicorn remains correct for sync WSGI; hybrid UvicornWorker optional not mandatory
Granian is 2.x (not pre-1.0); free-threaded mode experimental — avoid prod
Always configure trusted proxy headers correctly
action_items: Document server decision tree in references/python.md
Note Granian production adopters for confidence, still measure
checklist: Server pinned; no reload in prod
DB pools sized for worker count
Load test only if changing server class
conflicts_noted: DeployHQ 2026 guide still frames Granian as pre-1.0 and slightly lower maturity; GitHub shows Granian 2.7.9 (Jul 2026) with named production users — maturity improved but community still smaller than Uvicorn
Medium 2026 benchmarks claim large Granian wins; DeployHQ notes real DB-bound APIs often within 5–10% — trust measurement on your app
Whether Gunicorn+UvicornWorker is 'required' for prod: not required; process management can be k8s/systemd + uvicorn workers
